translations.literal: He again attacked Ava, seeking to bring out the Prince of Gui, but in the end did not obtain him; our army pressed deeper still.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Ava again to recover the prince but failed, while our forces pressed deeper.

sentences.zh: 文選據錫箔，憑江拒守。

translations.literal: Wenxuan held Xibo and relied on the river to resist and defend.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxuan held Xibo and defended the river line.

sentences.zh: 我師出木邦，造筏將渡，文選奔茶山。

translations.literal: Our army came out of Mubang, built rafts intending to cross; Wenxuan fled to Chashan.
translations.idiomatic: Our army advanced from Mubang and began building rafts to cross. Wenxuan fled to Chashan.

sentences.zh: 總兵馬寧將偏師追之，及於猛養，文選降。

translations.literal: Regional commander Ma Ning led a detached force in pursuit and caught up at Mengyang; Wenxuan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ma Ning pursued with a detached force, caught him at Mengyang, and Wenxuan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔封承恩公，亦隸漢軍正白旗。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed him as Duke of Chengen; he was also enrolled in the Plain White Banner of the Han military.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made him Duke of Chengen and enrolled him in the Han Eight Banners' Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，命予三等公俸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, he was ordered given third-class duke stipend.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 he was granted a third-class duke's stipend.

sentences.zh: 七年，加太子少師。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he was given Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 he died.

sentences.zh: 子繪，降襲一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: His son Hui inherited at reduced rank as first-class jingqi niha.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hui inherited at a reduced first-class jingqi niha rank.

sentences.zh: 卒，停襲。

translations.literal: He died; inheritance was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He died and the line was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 論曰：邦家新造，師行所至，逆者誅，順者庸。

translations.literal: The commentary says: The state was newly founded; wherever the army marched, the rebellious were executed and the compliant were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The historian comments: In a newly founded dynasty, wherever the army marched, rebels were punished and those who submitted were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 雖其人叛故國，賊舊君，苟為利於我，固不能不以為功也。

translations.literal: Even if a man betrayed his former state and harmed his former lord, if he brought advantage to us, he could not but be regarded as having merit.
translations.idiomatic: Even men who had betrayed their old country and harmed their former sovereign could not but be counted meritorious if they served the new dynasty's interest.

sentences.zh: 可望獨以台官言降爵，終見削奪。

translations.literal: Kewang alone, on the censor's words, had his rank reduced and in the end saw it stripped away.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang alone, on a censor's memorial, had his rank reduced and eventually lost it altogether.

sentences.zh: 唐通降自成，既復來歸，授世職，康熙間即停襲，事又在其前；

translations.literal: Tang Tong surrendered to Zicheng, then came back again; he was granted a hereditary office; in Kangxi inheritance was already stopped—this affair came even earlier;
translations.idiomatic: Tang Tong had surrendered to Li Zicheng and then returned; he received a hereditary rank, but inheritance was stopped in Kangxi—an even earlier case;

sentences.zh: 而定國、夢庚、雄輩及他諸降將，皆襲封如故。

translations.literal: Yet Dingguo, Menggeng, Xiong, and the rest, and other surrendering generals, all inherited enfeoffment as before.
translations.idiomatic: while Dingguo, Menggeng, Xiong, and the other defecting generals kept their hereditary titles intact.

sentences.zh: 民間傳雄負福王出，王咬其項，遂潰死。

translations.literal: Among the people it was said that Xiong carried the Prince of Fu out, the prince bit his neck, and he thereupon died of a burst wound.
translations.idiomatic: Popular rumor held that when Xiong carried off the Prince of Fu, the prince bit his neck and he died of the wound.

sentences.zh: 雄死時，明亡已二十年。

translations.literal: When Xiong died, the Ming had already perished twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong died twenty years after the fall of the Ming.

sentences.zh: 其言誠無稽，然民之所惡，蓋亦可見矣。

translations.literal: The saying truly has no basis, yet what the people detest may also be seen therein.
translations.idiomatic: The tale has no factual basis, yet it shows how deeply the people despised him.
